application_outbound_framing.scope: Current generic send routine0x639D0, not an assertion that any game application message was received.
application_outbound_framing.cmd0: 0x634D0 creates a default Cmd0 head. Serialized head length is12 with no command extension. Generic sender sets EncHeadLen4 and encrypts BE32 sequence plus serialized application bytes as body.
application_outbound_framing.lengths: HeadLen is the unencrypted serialized TPDU head length. BodyLen is the complete ciphertext length, including encryption of the four-byte sequence and padding; total frame bytes=HeadLen+BodyLen.
application_outbound_framing.decrypt_order: Use the newly installed key after successful CHGSKEY. AES3-decrypt frame[HeadLen:HeadLen+BodyLen], validate trailer/padding, require at least EncHeadLen bytes, and remove exactly the proven four-byte sequence prefix before treating remainder as application bytes.
application_outbound_framing.boundaries: Do not guess application message IDs, TDR schemas, account fields, Geo/Zone exchange or success replies from this envelope alone. Outbound application payload may include independent identity material and remains private.
